_note: Only items with status approved may appear in the app, the PDF or emails. Figures match the case studies on maisondelites.com (read 2026-10-09); the owner approved all of them.

clients.text: Walmart, Nintendo, WYDE, Sony and DEF JAM have run campaigns through the network.

walmart.title: Walmart beauty box
walmart.objective: Drive attention to Walmart’s beauty box.
walmart.strategy: Get creators to post about it.
walmart.text: Walmart used clipping to drive attention to its beauty box: 3M total views at an effective CPM of $2.30.

kojo_testimonial.title: Kojo Blak, artist
kojo_testimonial.text: Kojo Blak talks about working with Maison d’Élites.

paul_case.title: Jake and Logan Paul, Paul American
paul_case.objective: Drive views for their TV show, Paul American.
paul_case.strategy: Clippers reposted clips from episodes 2 and 3 at $2.00 per 1,000 views.
paul_case.text: Paul American, the TV show from Jake and Logan Paul: clippers reposted clips from episodes 2 and 3 at $2.00 per 1,000 views, for 11.2M total views at an effective CPM of $1.78.

wale_mannywellz.title: Mannywellz ft. Wale
wale_mannywellz.objective: Promote the Mannywellz ft. Wale release.
wale_mannywellz.strategy: Clippers across the network posted clips of the release.
wale_mannywellz.text: The Mannywellz ft. Wale release: 19 creators posted clips across the network for 4.6M total views at an effective CPM of $0.48.

kojo_case.title: Kojo Blak
kojo_case.objective: Promote Kojo Blak’s two latest songs: his feature with Fantana, and Excellent.
kojo_case.strategy: Clippers earned $2.00 per 1,000 views for posting clips of the release.
kojo_case.text: Kojo Blak’s feature with Fantana and his song Excellent: clippers earned $2.00 per 1,000 views posting clips, for 1.9M total views. He later won Best New Ghanaian Artist.
